races.name: Sky Sports Racing Aston Park Stakes (Group 3)

runners_data.name: West Wind Blows
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with William Buick aboard gets ideal tactical setup behind the lone leader and boasts strong recent form.

runners_data.name: Kalpana
runners_data.note: Natural front runner but the 210-day absence since last victory raises questions about race fitness despite her class edge.

runners_data.name: Liberty Lane
runners_data.note: Proven prominent racer who showed improved form when winning last time out and handles good ground well.

runners_data.name: Arabian Force
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who needs the pace to collapse but has Tom Marquand's tactical skills and solid recent efforts.

runners_data.name: French Master
runners_data.note: Another hold-up type with headgear on who needs a strong tempo but comes from the powerful Gosden stable.

races.paceDynamic: Kalpana will take the field along at a sustainable gallop from the front, with West Wind Blows and Liberty Lane tracking in prominent positions behind her. The modest field size and lack of multiple pace pressers means Kalpana can dictate terms without being harassed early. The gallop will be honest but not punishing, building gradually through the middle stages before the real test comes in the final three furlongs. This controlled tempo strongly favours prominent racers who can travel kindly behind the leader and have tactical speed to strike.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Kalpana maintains an even gallop without early pressure from the prominent trio
scenarios.body: She can measure out her effort perfectly and prove hard to peg back, while West Wind Blows gets an ideal tracking trip. The lack of early pace pressure allows the leader to save enough for a strong finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If West Wind Blows or Liberty Lane apply gentle pressure to quicken the tempo mid-race
scenarios.body: The pace becomes more testing which exposes any fitness concerns in Kalpana after her 210-day break. William Buick on West Wind Blows gets the perfect setup to strike approaching the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Challenge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays very slow and the race becomes a tactical crawl
scenarios.body: The hold-up pair Arabian Force and French Master get their preferred scenario of a sprint finish. Tom Marquand can deliver Arabian Force with a perfectly timed late surge to catch the prominent runners napping.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Kalpana Folds Late
scenarios.trigger: If Kalpana's long absence shows when the pressure mounts in the final quarter-mile
scenarios.body: Her 210-day layoff catches up as she weakens, opening the door for any of the closers. The prominent runners inherit the lead but become sitting ducks for late challengers with fresher legs.

watchPoints.text: Kalpana's jumping and early pace-setting - any sluggish start or inability to establish position will derail her chances
West Wind Blows getting too keen behind Kalpana - Buick must keep him settled to capitalize on the tactical advantage
The pace through the middle stages - if it becomes too sedate it transforms this into a completely different tactical contest
Arabian Force's position turning for home - Marquand needs to be close enough to strike when the pace lifts
Liberty Lane's response to pressure - her recent win came in easier company and this represents a class test

races.paceDynamic: Fractional will lead uncontested from the gates, setting a comfortable rhythm with no other natural front runners in this small field. The prominent quartet of Golden Orbit, Allaire, Esna and Lady Roisia will track in behind, with Sacred Ground likely held up at the rear by Buick. This sustainable pace will allow the field to stay in touch throughout, before quickening in the final 3f. The lack of early pressure on Fractional creates a tactical race that strongly favours the hold-up horses and closers who can produce a sustained finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Fractional gets soft fractions and stays on strongly
scenarios.body: The confirmed front runner exploits the lack of early pace pressure to dictate terms and prove hard to peg back. Marquand can time the kick perfectly having controlled the tempo throughout.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Class Tells Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens from 3f out as expected
scenarios.body: The superior rated horses Esna and Sacred Ground find another gear in the closing stages when the race becomes a true test. Their class advantage becomes decisive as stamina and acceleration combine.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Fresh Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Golden Orbit's 231-day break proves beneficial rather than rusty
scenarios.body: The long absence has freshened up the last-time-out winner who shows improved form stepping up in class. Ryan gets a perfect tow behind Fractional before striking late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Fractional stops quickly and creates a blanket finish
scenarios.body: The leader's stamina gives way in the final furlong allowing the entire field to close rapidly. The finish becomes a scramble where any of the prominent runners can prevail.

watchPoints.text: Fractional's early sectionals - if allowed to dawdle she becomes very dangerous
Sacred Ground's position turning in - Buick must have her within striking distance
Golden Orbit's jumping and early race keenness after the long layoff
Esna's racing room in the straight with Moore needing clear passage
The pace through halfway - slow fractions will suit Fractional, genuine pace favours the closers

The honest pace from Zeus Olympios prevents the hold-up horses from getting too far back, but the prominent traffic jam will create gaps and shuffling in the straight. This race shape clearly favours the patient hold-up horses who can pick their way through or around the prominent congestion when it matters most.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Power Play
scenarios.trigger: If The Lion In Winter or Damysus can secure an unimpeded run from their forward positions
scenarios.body: The class horses in the prominent group use their tactical advantage to get first run on Zeus Olympios. Their rating and form gives them the edge over the hold-up division.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Zeus Wire Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Zeus Olympios maintains his advantage and the closers leave their run too late on the testing ground

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sahlan Fresh Advantage
scenarios.trigger: If the French raider's 196-day break proves beneficial and he gets a dream trip from his prominent position

races.paceDynamic: Aqpan will take the field along from the start as the sole confirmed front runner, setting what should be a sustainable tempo without early pressure. Albert Einstein, Ghost Mode, Song Of The Clyde and Sirius A will track in prominent positions, while the strong hold-up contingent of Wise Approach, Royal Fixation and Havana Hurricane will settle towards the rear. With only one horse wanting the lead, this creates a moderate pace that builds gradually, allowing the talented hold-up horses to close strongly in the final two furlongs. This race shape clearly favours the hold-up brigade who can exploit the lack of early pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate as expected with Aqpan unchallenged early
scenarios.body: The lack of early speed allows the classy closers to position perfectly and unleash their superior finishing kicks. Wise Approach, Royal Fixation and Havana Hurricane can all produce devastating late runs from ideal tactical positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses apply more pressure than expected on Aqpan
scenarios.body: Albert Einstein and Ghost Mode can capitalize on their tactical positions to kick clear before the hold-up horses get organized. Their class tells when they get first run on the field from just behind the leader.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Aqpan Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If the Roger Varian-trained leader maintains his kick despite setting the pace
scenarios.body: His previous win from the front shows he can sustain a gallop, and with minimal early pressure he may have enough left to resist late challenges. The moderate early pace plays into his hands perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Aqpan goes too slow early and creates a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure speed test in the final furlong where any horse can win on the day. Form lines become less reliable in a bunched finish where positioning and luck dominate.

watchPoints.text: Wise Approach and Royal Fixation both returning from breaks - watch for any signs of rustiness in the preliminaries that could undermine their hold-up tactics
Aqpan's early pace setting - if he goes too fast trying to make all he plays into the hands of the closers, too slow and it becomes a lottery
Albert Einstein's positioning with Ryan Moore - needs to be handy enough to capitalize if the pace becomes truly testing

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the four leaders go too fast early and tie up badly in the final quarter-mile
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will empty the tanks of Zennor Storm, Magnatura and Arbaawy, allowing hold-up horses with tactical speed to sweep past in the closing stages. Lake Como and Sapphire Steps can capitalize on superior finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Lost Signal or Law Court can sit handy behind the pace and maintain their position
scenarios.body: The Richard Hannon pair can track the leaders without being caught up in early speed battles, positioning them perfectly to strike when the pace collapses. Their prominent style allows them to avoid trouble while staying close enough to pounce.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters can dictate more sensible fractions and see off challengers
scenarios.body: Euston Hall's recent Newbury win suggests he handles the track well and could control the tempo better than his rivals. His proven stamina at this trip gives him the edge if he can avoid a speed duel with the other leaders.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Strikes Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely strong and all the fancied runners are compromised by their positions
scenarios.body: Chapter and Media Legend, coming off long breaks, could benefit from reduced expectations and a truly-run race that suits their hold-up styles. Their fresh legs and lower weights could be decisive if the race unfolds chaotically.
